name: The Schoolmaster's Field Trip
summary: Finneas Trout wants five things the pupils can hold, and one thing told gently.

stages.journal: Finneas Trout wants a button from Pip Oakum, a fact from Old Rusty, a thread of the bell-rope, a chalk mark from the church, and one thing he will tell us about at the end.
stages.hint: Gather the things in the village, then see Finneas at the schoolhouse.
